newsitem.title: SAN MARINO: CYCLING-TONKOV CLAIMS PINK JERSEY AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-TONKOV CLAIMS PINK JERSEY AGAIN.

text.p: Pavel Tonkov won a Russian duel for Giro d'Italia leadership on Monday after an 18 km mountain time trial from Santarcangelo.
His 21 seconds victory over 1994 winner Yevgeny Berzin and his new 40 million lire ($24,000) bike gave the 1996 victor the pink jersey by one second.
Berzin's challenge on a prototype time trial special weighing only 8.5 kg faded as he cracked on a major climb trying to match Tonkov's time of 31 minutes 42 seconds.
Spain's Juan Carlos Dominguez was the fastest after 8.5 km but crashed on a bend and had to change bikes.
Roberto Petito was third but his Italian team mate and overnight leader Mario Cipollini was two minutes 47 seconds slower than Tonkov.
